en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a European town, likely late 19th or early 20th century. A broad unpaved street is lined with two‑ and three‑story masonry houses. On the right stands a large, ornate building with arched windows and decorative roof finials, set above a stone retaining wall and iron railing. Numerous townspeople, including women in long dresses, children playing, and a few men, stroll or gather along the street, giving it a leisurely atmosphere. On the façade of the large right‑hand building, a long German inscription is visible, identifying it as a guesthouse or inn (Gasthof).
